actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected complete portrait card. Image1 exact rejected raw full-resolution target. Image2 unchanged original game card controls exact source pose/hair/outfit/crop/light. Image3 literal mascot identity/compact rounded anatomy only. Correct ONLY the long exposed yellow throat inside open blouse. Remove the entire long tapering yellow triangle below chin. Keep compact near-round head with a broad very shallow SHORT rounded U lower face CLOSE beneath grey mouth. Raise and broaden actual blue-grey folded blouse neckline/collar around its base so only a tiny VERY SHORT BROAD yellow transition remains. Keep original OPEN blouse design and source pale blue-grey pointed folds/dark outer shoulder edges; do not close into high tunic, add white shirt, tie/bow, scarf or jewellery to hide defect. Front cloth before body, rear collar behind, coherent contact shadow and no floating/pinched/clipping fabric. Preserve actual near-frontal mild IMAGE-LEFT turn/roll/crop/light. Retain UNCOVERED dark BLACK/BROWN brushed-back wavy raised crown and tucked side hair, actual light grey highlight streak at IMAGE-RIGHT temple, real dark brow HAIR and CLEAN upper lip/chin. Literal LARGE GREEN-RINGED BLACK creature eyes, small GREY CLOSED mascot mouth and smooth golden-yellow anatomy, no human nose/lips/wrinkles. Keep OPEN BLUE-GREY/SLATE blouse with original dark lower/outer edges, no cap/spectacles/medals. Preserve OPAQUE BLUE-GREY backing, entire tilted dark rim and lower-right cream note overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, genuine alpha only outside whole card silhouette; tiny marks understated, no invented readable writing. No long yellow neck, low point, V funnel, shaft, cream bib or collar held below chin.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
